passage.label: Al-An'am — Who more unjust than fabricates lie against Allah or denies signs? wrongdoers not succeed; Day gather all ask polytheists where partners? swear by Allah we were not polytheists; see how lied against selves lost what fabricated; some listen but coverings on hearts deafness in ears see every sign still disbelieve; argue legends of former peoples; prohibit from it avoid it destroy only selves perceive not; if could see standing before Fire wish returned not deny signs be believers; appeared what concealed; if returned would return forbidden indeed liars; say nothing but worldly life not resurrected; stand before Lord is this truth? yes by our Lord taste punishment for disbelief

arabicExcerpts.text: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوۡ كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
وَيَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُهُمۡ جَمِيعٗا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُوٓاْ أَيۡنَ شُرَكَآؤُكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمۡ تَزۡعُمُونَ
ثُمَّ لَمۡ تَكُن فِتۡنَتُهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ وَٱللَّهِ رَبِّنَا مَا كُنَّا مُشۡرِكِينَ
ٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَذَبُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡۚ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ

وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَسۡتَمِعُ إِلَيۡكَۖ وَجَعَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفۡقَهُوهُ وَفِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرٗاۚ وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كُلَّ ءَايَةٖ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِهَاۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوكَ يُجَٰدِلُونَكَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
وَهُمۡ يَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنۡهُ وَيَنۡـَٔوۡنَ عَنۡهُۖ وَإِن يُهۡلِكُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
وَلَوۡ تَرَىٰٓ إِذۡ وُقِفُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَقَالُواْ يَٰلَيۡتَنَا نُرَدُّ وَلَا نُكَذِّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّنَا وَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
بَلۡ بَدَا لَهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُخۡفُونَ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَلَوۡ رُدُّواْ لَعَادُواْ لِمَا نُهُواْ عَنۡهُ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَبۡعُوثِينَ
وَلَوۡ تَرَىٰٓ إِذۡ وُقِفُواْ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡۚ قَالَ أَلَيۡسَ هَٰذَا بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَاۚ قَالَ فَذُوقُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ

mainSubject.label: Fabrication-denial as supreme injustice; wrongdoers' failure guaranteed; eschatological interrogation exposing polytheists' self-deception through false oaths; heart-coverings and ear-deafness as divine barriers preventing comprehension despite sign-exposure; legends-dismissal as argumentative strategy; self-destructive prohibition-avoidance unrecognized; hypothetical fire-standing scene revealing regret and desire for return; exposed concealment and inevitable reversion to forbidden if returned; materialist worldview denial of resurrection; standing before Lord confirming truth followed by punishment-tasting

subordinateSubjects.label: Supreme injustice defined as fabrication against Allah or sign-denial
False oath defense: swearing by Allah we were not polytheists
Self-directed lying: kathaboo AAala anfusihim and loss of fabricated deities
Sign-saturation still insufficient for belief: even seeing every sign rejected
Dual prohibition-avoidance: preventing others and avoiding themselves
Unrecognized self-destruction: yuhlikoona illa anfusahum wama yashAAuroona
Hypothetical fire-standing: regret-wish for return and belief
Inevitable reversion to forbidden even if returned: innahum lakathiboona
Materialist creed: only worldly life no resurrection
Standing before Lord: truth confirmed by oath then punishment tasted

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Heart-coverings and ear-deafness as divinely placed cognitive-spiritual barriers
Regret at fire-standing: desire for return and belief after seeing punishment
Confirmed liar-status: even if returned would revert to forbidden
Unperceived self-destruction: destroying only themselves without awareness

notes: Pass A An'am passage 3/4. Extended eschatological-psychological analysis of disbelief. Supreme-injustice definition (6:21) establishes fabrication and sign-denial as worst possible acts. Eschatological interrogation (6:22-24) exposes self-deception mechanism: polytheists lie even to themselves under divine oath. Heart-ear barrier system (6:25) explains persistent rejection despite evidence saturation. Legends-dismissal (asateeru al-awwaleena) identified as intellectual defense mechanism. Self-destruction paradox (6:26) shows prohibition-enforcers harming only themselves unknowingly. Fire-regret scene (6:27-28) demonstrates post-hoc recognition is worthless: return would produce same rejection confirming volitional nature of disbelief. Materialist creed quotation (6:29) gives voice to opposing worldview before refuting it through standing-before-Lord scene (6:30). Truth-oath-punishment sequence (6:30) shows confession comes too late.
